# Commitprompt

> Commitprompt is a dependency-light, package-manager-neutral Conventional Commits CLI and JavaScript API. It provides an interactive human workflow and machine-readable commands for AI agents, using each repository's Commitlint configuration or included conventional defaults.

Commitprompt is published as `@santi020k/commitprompt`. AI agents should inspect
the target repository and staged diff, run `commitprompt types --json` and
`commitprompt scopes --json`, format structured input, and validate before
committing. A non-interactive commit requires the explicit `--yes` flag and
leaves Git hooks enabled.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://commitprompt.santi020k.com/docs/): Installation, interactive use, repository rules, automation commands, and programmatic API.
- [Full LLM reference](https://commitprompt.santi020k.com/llms-full.txt): Self-contained AI-oriented command and API reference.
- [AI agent guide](https://github.com/santi020k/commitprompt/blob/main/packages/commitprompt/AI.md): Safe workflow, structured input, output, and exit-code contracts.
- [Package README](https://github.com/santi020k/commitprompt/blob/main/packages/commitprompt/README.md): Complete package documentation.

## Source and package

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/santi020k/commitprompt): Source, tests, issues, and releases.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@santi020k/commitprompt): Published package metadata and installation.
